title: Chapter 325: The Huge Impact Destroyed The Dragon-Breaking Stone
content:
Chapter 325: The Huge Impact Destroyed The Dragon-Breaking Stone

Wang Shuo had to marvel at the sturdiness of this human ladder.

A closer look revealed that the bones of the monsters on the human ladder were actually stuck together, interlocking to form a stable flat rope shape.

Wang Shuo immediately jumped and chopped.

But he did not cut off the claws of the skeleton monster on the top of the human ladder.

Suddenly, the skeleton monster stretched out more claws, tightly grasped the battlements, and even stretched out some bone spurs, directly piercing into the city wall.

Wang Shuo was shocked.

He looked up.

In the distance, countless undead warriors had stepped on the human ladder and rushed over.

Moreover, there were as many as 8 human ladders like this at the East Gate alone.

In the sky, there were also huge dragon-shaped undead, with undead warriors crawling on their two bone claws.

When flying over Shanhai City, the undead dragon swooped down, and the undead warriors jumped down one after another and began to attack the surrounding human soldiers.

Not only that, the stone-throwing monsters before no longer threw stones, but directly threw undead warriors.

Lost the protection of the shield.

The number of undead warriors on the city wall and in Shanhai City increased rapidly.

The speed of the undead's attack was so fast that it was hard to keep up.

"Reinforcement, reinforcement, I need reinforcement here..."

Some lords who couldn't hold on shouted loudly.

Fortunately, these lords who reinforced Shanhai City had already exchanged the dead spirit talisman last night, otherwise the situation would be out of control at this time.

Wang Shuo divided the generals into two teams, and along the two ends of the city wall, they continued to help the lords who couldn't hold on and kill the undead warriors.

"Bang."

Suddenly, there was a loud noise.

Wang Shuo couldn't help shaking his gun hand. He didn't need to look to know that the explosion was caused by the "giant impact" hitting the broken dragon stone.

Wang Shuo couldn't help looking back, took a look, and his heart was immediately chilled.

The gate tower of the entire city was blown down.

The main attack direction of the undead this time was the East Gate.

Zhao Bangde stood at the gate of the East Gate, looking at General Arif Ubol from a distance.

Zhao Bangde was quite calm, without any panic, and even smiled at the enemy commander.

Wang Shuo also saw Zhao Bangde's expression.

His face was very anxious, and his heart was in a panic.

The undead had attacked the city wall and entered the city.

This is really urgent!

You are still pretending!

After taking a deep breath, Wang Shuo couldn't help but wonder, does Zhao Bangde have a trump card?

Yes, there should be, otherwise, it's time to pack up and run away.

Wang Shuo kicked a skeleton away and looked at the enemy boss again.

There were 10 generals around him, on his left and right sides.

Wang Shuo was so excited that he almost cried!

Is it so exciting!

The enemy's ultimate combat power has not moved yet, and the defense of Shanhai City is about to collapse.

The main force of the Burning Legion has the same combat power as the Black Armor Army.

The Red Flame Army needs three to five people to defeat one person.

At present, the undead skeletons that rushed up the city wall and entered the city can barely be dealt with.

The generals' team quickly gathered near several ladders to prevent the skeleton warriors from climbing the city.

As for those who were thrown up and airlifted in, there was no way.

Even the bronze crossbow carts had poor anti-air effects, and the number of undead warriors continued to increase.

Wang Shuo's generals' team was assigned to defend four ladders.

Wang Shuo assigned the manpower and came to the one closest to the city wall.

A gun shot an undead warrior off the city wall, and Gong Zheng jumped up and held up his shield to resist the enemy.

The width of the ladder was only 8 decimeters.

Gong Zheng could defend it alone.

Wang Shuo thought that the city wall without the protection of the formation could be blown up.

He directly took out 20 thunder bombs.
